question: What's the best 16-bay AA/AAA battery charger under $60?
query: best 16 bay AA AAA battery charger under $60 2026 reviews price

replays.text:
**Best overall under $60: [Tenergy TN438 16-bay AA/AAA charger](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-lcd-smart-battery-charger/)** — listed at **$57.99**. It charges up to 16 NiMH cells, with each bay operating independently, plus LCDs and a refresh mode. That makes it a strong pick if you regularly charge a large, mixed pile of batteries. [Price and specs](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-nimh-charger)

For a cheaper option, the [BONAI 16-bay charger](https://cartechtalk.com/best-battery-charger-for-aa-and-aaa-batteries/) is listed at **$29.44** and offers independent charging with per-bay LED indicators. It’s a good value, but has fewer listed features.

Both are for **NiMH rechargeable batteries**—not alkaline or lithium cells.

**Best pick: [Tenergy TN438 16-bay AA/AAA NiMH charger](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-lcd-smart-battery-charger/).** It’s listed at **$57.99**, just under your budget, and offers 16 independent charging slots, two LCDs, and a refresh mode. It charges AA NiMH cells at 500 mA and AAA cells at 250 mA; the listing gives about 5.2–6.5 hours for 16 AAs, depending on capacity. ([price and specs](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-nimh-charger))

If you’d rather save money than get the LCD and refresh features, the **BONAI 16-bay** is a lower-cost alternative listed at $29.44, with independent LED status indicators for each bay. It’s for NiMH cells too. ([comparison](https://cartechtalk.com/best-battery-charger-for-aa-and-aaa-batteries/))

**Note:** These chargers are for rechargeable NiMH batteries—not alkaline or lithium AA/AAA cells.

**Best pick: [Tenergy TN438 16-Bay AA/AAA NiMH Charger](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-lcd-smart-battery-charger/)** — listed at **$57.99**, just under your budget. It has 16 independent charging slots, LCD displays, and a refresh mode, making it the more feature-rich choice for charging a large batch. ([Price and specs](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-nimh-charger))

If you’d rather spend less, the [BONAI 16-bay charger](https://cartechtalk.com/best-battery-charger-for-aa-and-aaa-batteries/) is listed at **$29.44** and supports independently charging mixed AA and AAA NiMH cells, but the results don’t list the same LCD and refresh features.

**Compatibility note:** These are for rechargeable **NiMH** cells—not alkaline or 1.5V lithium AA/AAA batteries.
